summary.one_liner: This page is the index of Prisma's Data Guide, linking to introductory articles and per-database guides covering relational, document, and other database types.
takeaways: Each database type (relational, document, etc.) has its own strengths and weaknesses, so choose based on your use case.
Relational databases suit highly structured data with flexible querying; document databases suit flexible data with high scalability.
The guide provides setup, connection, authentication, and querying tutorials for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, SQL Server, and MongoDB.
Related topics include ORMs, migrations, replication, OLAP vs OLTP, caching, backups, and serverless databases.
summary.summary: This is the landing page for Prisma's Data Guide, which introduces databases, data modeling, and database types. It describes relational and document databases and offers an index of per-database guides for PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, Microsoft SQL Server, and MongoDB covering setup, users, queries, and data types. It also links to articles on ORMs, migrations, replication, backups, and serverless architecture. The page itself is mostly a table of contents, so the detail sits in the linked articles.
